items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Like, for instance, I mean like Ray Brown said once in an interview that he was playing with Charlie Parker... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, right.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Were you -- did you -- were you working out, like say, were you getting together like with any of the piano players or other bass players that you remember at

that time, working on like different kinds of ways to get to different kinds of harmonic areas, so to speak. Like, for instance, I mean like Ray Brown said once in an interview that he was playing with Charlie Parker. It was either Charlie Parker or Coleman Hawkins. He and the piano player, whose name I don't recall at this moment, used to get together and work out different ways they'd come. They'd take the chorus to the bridge or something.
